player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''PIET''') posted a [[Light]] Ewok list on DeckTech in May 2000.
description: DO NOT PANIC yes this is an ewok deck, and yes, it has won 2 out of 3 on the national. It is called Maarten's terrible horrible fuzzy bear attack part II
cards: posted: Threepio aka the God x2
posted: Were you looking for me? x3
posted: Nar shadda wind chimes x2
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: Starting sites as posted under 'Start': Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut and Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest) (no objective; starting.card set to the first-listed site). Total 60 as published.

'EPP obi' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber and 'epp luke' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Dos' Daughter Of Skywalker; 'R3po' R-3PO (Ar-Threepio); 'Threepio aka the God' the Endor Threepio (Threepio (Endor)); 'Back door', 'Landing platform', 'Dense forest' the Light Endor sites.
The list matches Rossou's 'Fuzzy Bear Attack' on Trandosite card for card apart from the two starting sites, which that 58-card page omits (the description calls this one 'part II').

Titled "Ryloth National co-winning deck"; the post says "it has won 2 out of 3 on the national" (the Dutch national championship of spring 2000). The wiki has no page for that event, so it is filed as a general deck.
player_note: The post is titled 'Ryloth National co-winning deck' and its description says: "yes this is an ewok deck, and yes, it has won 2 out of 3 on the national"; an edit adds that Dutch commenters "were surprised i had the guts to play them furrballs at the nationals" (posted 24 May 2000; the post gives no date or venue for the event).
